items.title: Java4Shell Vulnerability
items.summary: On November 17, 2026, details emerged exposing a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in OpenJDK, tracked as CVE-2026-114938 (dubbed “Java4Shell”) with a CVSSv3.1 score of 8.1 (High).

items.title: What's New in ArcGIS Enterprise 12.2
items.summary: ArcGIS Enterprise 12.2 for Windows and Linux is here. This release provides enhancements and new functionality for GIS administrators, GIS developers, and GIS analysts.

items.title: How to Use MPKX Files in QGIS
items.summary: With so many public agencies, particularly in the United States, relying almost exclusively on Esri’s proprietary GIS software, it’s not uncommon to find geographic data packaged or compressed in formats designed for ArcGIS.

items.title: GIS File Formats
items.summary: GIS work involves dozens of file formats. Some store geographic data, while others are created by GIS software to save a map or project.
